original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非一政界人士追悼会后发生枪击 至少四人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非卡特洪镇一场地方政界人士追悼会结束后，一名枪手向离开的哀悼者开枪，警方称至少四人死亡、三人受伤。警方表示，一名伤者为儿童，嫌疑人已自首并被拘留。当局最初称两名男子在现场死亡，随后在周三将死亡人数上调至四人。

key_facts.fact: 南非卡特洪镇追悼会后发生枪击，至少四人死亡、三人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A gunman fired on a group of mourners leaving a memorial service for a local politician in South Africa, killing at least four people and injuring three others, police said Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: 伤者中至少有一名儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least one of those wounded in the shooting late Tuesday in Katlehong township was a child

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人已自首并被拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect was in custody after turning himself in

key_facts.fact: 警方最初称两名男子在现场死亡，后死亡人数上调至四人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police initially said two men died at the scene southeast of Johannesburg, but authorities raised the death toll to four after two more people died in a hospital on Wednesday.

uncertainties: 事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
